However, several minor AI artifacts prevent a perfect authenticity score: (1) The license plate text '6 FLWRS 68' exhibits slight character warping and inconsistent kerning typical of generative text rendering. (2) There is subtle boundary fusion where the purple delphinium stem overlaps the car door handle area, lacking crisp occlusion boundaries. (3) The front wheel hubcap reflection appears slightly smeared and generic rather than reflecting precise environmental geometry. These are low-severity defects that do not significantly detract from overall quality but indicate synthetic origin.
